knownLauncher.status: Coordinator local build only; no Windows qualification

admissionWithoutNewMechanism: Use the existing coordinator as sole owner of test admission and host/financial changes for this bounded window. Do not add a production scheduler, global lock service or on-chain operation.

Immediately before the one attempt, re-observe actual8091+8095 health/inventory/epochs and8097 durable pending reservation. Count full physical memory of all starting domains plus router pending not already represented; count future already-admitted but not-started work and other known host work from current coordinator records. Never translate unobserved work to zero. Double counting is safe; unproven deduplication is not.

Require explicit accounted pending upper bound P and fresh OS available physical F >= 17408 + 256 + P MiB; this retains the existing17GiB routing reserve plus the entire test commit budget initially. Also require available commit >=256MiB. These are additional launch checks, not a claim of an atomic reservation.

Existing17GiB router admission floor has1GiB above the desired16GiB minimum; the256MiB owned test fits inside that margin under accounted admissions. Launcher pressure checks at17GiB every50ms kill only this test if margin shrinks. Pressure sampling is best effort, not a proof that future/concurrent jobs cannot consume memory.

Coordinator must account for/prohibit overlapping new work it controls during the <=30sec attempt. If uncontrolled direct launches or pending commitments cannot be bounded, leave the test unadmitted. Do not stop production apps or claim future capacity zero.

minimalQualificationSequence.name: Disposable source/build and staging review
minimalQualificationSequence.action: Prepare a tiny no-CRT Win32 probe as a separate source-only artifact; coordinator alone reviews/builds it using existing toolchain, pins binary/source/imports. Do not Add-Type or compile on Windows during the test. Use one exact randomly named private directory and whitelisted pinned launcher/probe files, protected ACL/reparse/link checks and ownership marker. No production journal paths.

minimalQualificationSequence.name: Readback and inheritance
minimalQualificationSequence.action: Record immediate-job numeric flags, commit cap, active process limit, affinity and exact probe/first-child/recovery-child PID+creation FILETIME strings. Child exit zero means its own immediate-job limits matched the pinned constants. This does not identify all ancestors or prove an exclusive job identity.

minimalQualificationSequence.name: Bounded behavioral checks in same owned job
minimalQualificationSequence.action: Collect slot-four creation, slot-five attempt, breakaway attempt and normal-child recovery receipts with immediate raw GetLastError on each failure and before/after active/total/terminated counts. Allocate/touch at most256MiB in1MiB chunks, capture immediate allocation error, historical job peak commit before/after, available system commit/physical, free errors and positive allocation recovery. No arbitrary CreateProcess/VirtualAlloc failure is called enforcement success. Historical peak near cap is supporting evidence only, not current commit or causal attribution. All waits/allocations remain bounded.

minimalQualificationSequence.name: Exit/death cleanup observation
minimalQualificationSequence.action: A successful limits run alone must NOT label kill-on-close qualified. For actual death coverage, root needs one separately reviewed observer controlling the exact created wrapper process handle and a child receipt, kills only that handle, then confirms its recorded descendants absent. Charge observer overhead separately in P and bound its lifetime. If this is not approved/composed, explicitly leave owner-death/kill-on-close qualification pending instead of setting booleans from source. Normal parent exit plus ownedjob termination can be checked in first run, but is not unexpected owner-death evidence.

minimalQualificationSequence.name: Record and clean
minimalQualificationSequence.action: Output only fixed-size structured PID/creation/limits/results, no environment/private data. Exact owned files only, nonrecursive cleanup after known processes gone. If timeout/pressure/transport loss leaves outcome unknown, record incomplete evidence and owned path for coordinator inspection; no broad sweep or automatic retry.

limits.watchdogStarts: After own-job assignment, before CreateProcess. Early setup is not independently bounded.

exclusions: No EXLOCK file test until Job qualification and current admission independently reviewed.
No NTFS powerloss,Windows guard,realVM orBase claim from this probe.
The separate observer is not silently included in256MiB job cap; budget/qualification scope must say so.
Revised launcher watchdog uses entry baseline but begins after selfjobassignment; early setup before watchdog remains outside independenttimeout.
nextConcreteWork: Coordinator source review first. No build, run, staging, retry or follow-on authorized. Any observed result needs independent causal assessment; unknown errors remain unknown.

concreteFiles.job-probe.c: Version2 receipt-only source. Actual numeric limits, exact PID/creation, immediate failure errors and accounting/positive controls. evidenceCollected means required observations collected, even when observations contradict expected behavior. scopePassed, limitAttributionQualified and ownerDeathQualified always false. Exit0 is NOT a qualification pass.
